metadata.title: Generalized Frobenius manifolds: symmetries and their classification in 2-dimensions
metadata.abstract: A theory of symmetries of generalized Frobenius manifolds is developed. This is used to study the solution space of all generalized Frobenius manifolds that are "above" a specific Frobenius manifold. Since all (semi-simple) Frobenius manifolds in 2-dimensions are known, by constructing all homogeneous Legendre fields associated to these manifolds we classify all 2-dimensional generalized Frobenius manifolds. With this description, the known examples of generalized Frobenius manifolds correspond to distinguished points in this solution space. For Hurwitz-Frobenius manifolds the action of a Legendre transformation on Hurwitz space data, and in particular the primary differential, is given.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 作者发展广义Frobenius流形的对称性理论，刻画位于给定Frobenius流形之上的广义结构解空间。通过已知二维半单Frobenius流形及其所有齐次Legendre场，给出二维广义Frobenius流形分类，并将已有例子定位为解空间中的特定点。对于Hurwitz–Frobenius流形，给出Legendre变换对Hurwitz空间数据，尤其对主微分的作用。
techniques: 二维半单模型及齐次Legendre场
analysis.breakthrough: 以可构造的齐次Legendre场参数化二维广义结构，并在Hurwitz模型中追踪变换的具体数据。
analysis.limitations: 摘要中的分类路线以二维半单Frobenius模型为基础，具体参数等价关系和半单性在分类中的精确范围需查正文。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
